title: Topics in German Philosophy Translation—Intermediate
description: Careful, line-by-line translation of passages of intermediate difficulty from German philosophical texts, both classic (Kant, Fichte, Hegel, Schopenhauer) and contemporary (Heidegger, Wittgenstein, Habermas). P/NP grades only. May be repeated for credit two times with change of content. LIGM 1D or equivalent level of study recommended. Prerequisites: consent of instructor and preauthorization.
